warnings: This is 0.11d2's CLIENT half only. The R2 halves of both criteria stay open and are listed under unjudgeable.
No job_photos row is written, so the photo does not appear in the list afterwards; the press is judged on the wire and on the absence of a refusal, not on the list.
Supabase Storage READS are recorded separately and are not counted as uploads.

criteria: no upload request reaches Supabase Storage (client half of criterion 1)
the client cannot state the recorded size (client half of criterion 2)
dimensions.intercepted: photo-door, the signed PUT, and /storage/v1/object — the door is undeployed and there is no R2 credential here, so these are the responses that cannot be arranged
unjudgeable: that R2 accepts a signature it minted itself — needs the release and an R2 credential
that R2's head states the stored object's real length, and that job_photos.bytes equals it — needs a real object in a real bucket; proved in memory by tests/photo-door-server.test.mjs 11 and 13

assertion_floor: 7 per width (input, module-ran, start+finish, one PUT, body==claim, no Storage write, no size at finish, server's figure accepted) x 2 widths + 1 console = 15 when both widths press. A width whose screen never renders books its checks as failures rather than dropping out, so the count cannot silently fall below 12.

canary.what: a wire log with one Supabase Storage POST and a finish body naming bytes, put through the real judge()
canary.rule: storageWrites === 0 && no size key at finish
